scripts.build: pnpm --filter @ai-adventure/shared build && pnpm --filter @ai-adventure/api build && pnpm --filter @ai-adventure/web build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @ai-adventure/shared build && pnpm --filter @ai-adventure/api typecheck && pnpm --filter @ai-adventure/web typecheck
scripts.test: pnpm prisma:generate && pnpm --filter @ai-adventure/shared test && pnpm --filter @ai-adventure/api test && pnpm --filter @ai-adventure/web test
scripts.test:coverage: pnpm prisma:generate && pnpm --filter @ai-adventure/shared exec vitest run --coverage && pnpm --filter @ai-adventure/api exec vitest run --coverage && pnpm --filter @ai-adventure/web exec vitest run --coverage
